response.note_text:
53F with DM and elevated BP presents with chest pain x3 months. Dull, pressure-like CP brought on by walking, now limiting her walking. No radiation. Pain-free today; no SOB, sweats or clamminess now. DM on metformin, no N/V/D or med side effects; BG slightly higher d/t reduced activity, trying with diet, likes sodas. Last HbA1c 7.0. Ophthalmology appt in 2 wks. BP elevated with upward trend per other clinicians, not formally diagnosed, no BP meds; pt unaware. FHx heart disease.

Office EKG normal, no signs of MI. Exam: no JVD, no neck swelling, no carotid bruits. Lungs clear, no crackles or rhonchi. RRR with known 2/6 systolic ejection murmur. Pulses equal. Abd soft, NT, no guarding or masses. Back normal. 1+ nonpitting ankle edema, no calf tenderness.

Chest pain suspicious for unstable angina given DM, suspected HTN and FHx; concern for blockage. DM doing fairly well. Elevated BP trend, likely HTN, with LE edema.

Refer cardiology, aim next wk, for stress test. Start ASA 81 mg daily. Rx SL NTG prn CP: not needed if CP stops with rest; if CP persists take 1 tab, may repeat q5min up to 3 tabs; if not relieved call 911 / go to hospital. Continue metformin 500 mg BID, keep ophthalmology appt for diabetic retinopathy exam, HbA1c today, avoid soda and sweets, resume exercise once cardiac w/u done. Start low-dose HCTZ, also for LE swelling. Home BP cuff, daily AM log, enter in MyChart. Counselled on SE: increased evening urination, possible cross-reaction with sulfa meds; handout given. F/u 2 wks.
